summary: Wears the shape of whoever it last saw. Approaches with their gait, their voice, their unfinished sentences.
emotional_origin: Someone died in the ash steps with their name unsaid over them. Without a name to keep, it began collecting other people's.
revealed_trait: Its own name, which no living person has spoken in eleven years.
revelation_hint: It copies everything except one thing: it cannot copy what it does not have. Ask it who it was.
capture_requirement: Weaken it below a third of its strength while it is wearing your own face.
release_requirement: Speak its true name aloud during the Revelation.
reconcile_requirement: Speak its true name aloud and refuse the killing blow.
journal_entry_on_discovery: A woman on the ash steps called me by a name that is not mine, then apologised for the mistake and kept walking. She has been dead since the second frost.
journal_entry_on_understanding: It never meant to steal. It was buried without a name and had nothing left to hold onto, so it started borrowing. Say its name back to it and the whole thing comes apart gently.
